5400.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of anuvāta

examples.text: sīlagandhasamo gandho, kuto nāma bhavissati, yo samaṃ anuvāte ca, paṭivāte ca vāyati.

kacci mayaṃ, bhante, evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino c'eva bhagavato homa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāma, dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākaroma, na ca koci sahadhammiko vāda-anuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī'ti?

5410.commentary: (SNa) anuvikkhitto'ti idha bhikkhu chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto nisīdati. ath'assa kāmaguṇ'ārammaṇe cittaṃ vikkhipati. (SNt) vatthukāme ārabbha vikkhitto punappunaṃ vikkhitto hoti'y'evā'ti vuttaṃ anuvikkhitto'ti.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhitto chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando bahiddhā pañca kāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhitto anuvisaṭo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhitto chando.

5411.meaning2: considers, regards; takes notice of, takes account of

5412.meaning1: wanders about; roams about (from somewhere to)

examples.text: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhante, ārāmena ārāmaṃ, uyyānena uyyānaṃ anucaṅkamāmi anuvicarāmi. so'haṃ tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte, na viya maññe cakkhuṃ bandhante janassa dassanāya.

5414.commentary: (MNa) anuvicarante'ti ito c'ito ca vicarante, ito pana gehā nikkhamitvā etaṃ gehaṃ, etasmā vā nikkhamitvā imaṃ gehaṃ pavisanavasena'pi daṭṭhabbā.

examples.text: tattha cakkhumā puriso majjhe ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante'pi nikkhamante'pi anucaṅkamante'pi anuvicarante'pi

5415.commentary: (MNa) jaṅghāvihāran'ti jaṅghākilamathavinodan'atthaṃ jaṅghācāraṃ. anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno'ti ārāmadassana-vanadassana-pabbatadassan'ādīnaṃ atthāya ito c'ito ca vicaramāno. adhiccanikkhamano kir'esa kadāci deva nikkhamitvā evaṃ vicarati.

examples.text: daṇḍapāṇi'pi kho sakko jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami
atha kho hatthako āḷavako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasa bhagavantaṃ gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare nisinnaṃ.

5416.meaning2: makes walk all round, makes explore

examples.text: atha kho sakko ca devānam'indo vessavaṇo ca mahārājā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ vejayante pāsāde anucaṅkamāpenti anuvicarāpenti, idam'pi, mārisa moggallāna, passa vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakaṃ
yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi.
yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ, anuvicaritaṃ manasā tam'pi etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassati
tassa atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati. chandajāto tehi dhammehi saṃyutto hoti.
api ca kho me aticiraṃ anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato kāyo kilameyya. kāye kilante cittaṃ ūhaññeyya. ūhate citte ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā'ti.
no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkeyyāsi anuvicāreyyāsi manasā anupekkheyyāsi
lok'āmis'ādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī c'eva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañ'ca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañ'ca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati

5422.meaning1: having re-looked (at); having re-examined; having reflected (on)

examples.text: yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, divā kamm'ante ārabbha rattiṃ anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, ayaṃ rattiṃ dhūmāyanā. yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, rattiṃ anuvitakketvā anuvicāretvā divā kamm'ante payojeti kāyena vācāya manasā, ayaṃ divā pajjalanā.

5425.meaning2: thinks or ponders over; meditates upon

5426.synonym: anuvicinanta, anuvitakkayanta, anuvitakkenta, cintayanta, cintayamāna, cintenta, nijjhāyanta, paccavekkhanta, vitakkenta

examples.text: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu, saddhammā na parihāyati.
cirarattaṃ vat'ātāpī, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, samaṃ cittassa n'ālatthaṃ, pucchaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe.

5428.meaning2: thinks or ponders over; meditates upon

5429.meaning1: having thought over; having pondered over; having meditated upon

examples.text: idam'āyasmā ānando māgadhake paricārake ārabbha eko raho anuvicintetvā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

5430.meaning1: investigating; finding out; learning about; knowing about

examples.text: yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.
kacci nu kho maṃ anuvicca viññū sabrahmacārī sīlato na upavadantī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

5431.commentary: (MNa) anuviccakāran'ti anuvicāretvā cintetvā tulayitvā kātabbaṃ karohī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: anuviccakāraṃ kho, gahapati, karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī'ti.

5438.meaning2: being sought out; being investigated; being examined

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisaṃ sallena anuvijjheyyuṃ. tam'enaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvijjheyyuṃ. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso dvisallena vedanaṃ vedayati.
anussareyya sambuddhaṃ, dhammañ'ca-anuvitakkaye, abyāpajjaṃ hitaṃ cittaṃ, devalokāya bhāvaye.
tassa atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati. chandajāto tehi dhammehi saṃyutto hoti.
api ca kho me aticiraṃ anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato kāyo kilameyya. kāye kilante cittaṃ ūhaññeyya. ūhate citte ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā'ti.
so tathā vūpakaṭṭho viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ anussarati anuvitakketi.
yaññad'eva, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bahulam'anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, tathā tathā nati hoti cetaso.

examples.text: yadā kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha kho yo nesaṃ pāṇakānaṃ balavataro assa tassa te anuvatteyyuṃ, anuvidhāyeyyuṃ vasaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.

na > an + upa + ne + ti
an + upaneti

examples.text: diṭṭhim'pi lokasmiṃ na kappayeyya, ñāṇena vā sīlavatena vā'pi, samo'ti attānam'anūpaneyya, hīno na maññetha visesi vā'pi.
upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attā nirattā na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.
yā kāc'imā sammutiyo puthujjā, sabbā'va etā na upeti vidvā, anūpayo so upayaṃ kim'eyya, diṭṭhe sute khantim'akubbamāno.

5488.meaning1: not smeared; not sullied; untainted; unstained (by)
5488.commentary: (THa) sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto'ti sabbesu ārammaṇesu dhammesu taṇhādiṭṭhilepavasena na upalitto, tena lābh'ādilokadhamme samatikkamaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.
na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhim'āha, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto, attañ'jaho na'y'idha pakubbamāno.

5495.meaning1: with many births; having multiple lives
